desc:
Houses are built one after another along a straight road; positions[i] is the coordinate of the i-th house. After each new house is built, the residents want to choose one meeting point (any integer coordinate) that minimises the total walking distance of all houses built so far, where a house at x walks |x - meeting point|.

Return an array whose i-th entry is that minimum total distance once the first i + 1 houses exist.

positions = [4, 1, 7, 2]
[4]          -> 0
[4, 1]       -> 3   (meet anywhere from 1 to 4)
[4, 1, 7]    -> 6   (meet at 4: 0 + 3 + 3)
[4, 1, 7, 2] -> 8   (meet at 2: 2 + 1 + 5 + 0)
answer = [0, 3, 6, 8]
constraints: Every answer fits in a 32-bit signed integer
hints: The best meeting point for a set of numbers is always a median of the set. The hard part is keeping the median while numbers keep arriving.
Split the houses into a lower half and an upper half (two heaps). Everything in the lower half is walking right to the median, everything in the upper half is walking left.
Keep the sum of each half. With median m: cost = (sum of upper half - |upper| * m) + (|lower| * m - sum of lower half).
editorial: For a multiset of points, sum |x - c| is minimised at a median. Moving the meeting point one step to the right helps the points on its right and hurts the points on its left, so the optimum sits where both sides are balanced, the median. For an even count any point between the two middle values is optimal, so the lower median gives the same cost.

Hold the smaller half in a max-heap lo and the larger half in a min-heap hi, sizes equal or lo one larger, and also track sum(lo) and sum(hi). The median is the root of lo. Everything in hi is at least the median and everything in lo is at most the median, so no absolute values are needed: cost = sum(hi) - sum(lo) + (|lo| - |hi|) * median.
Each insertion costs O(log n) and the cost is read in O(1), for O(n log n) total. A sorted list with binary insertion is O(n<sup>2</sup>) in the worst case because of the shifting.
solution:
import heapq


def prefixGatherCosts(positions):
    lo, hi = [], []  # lo: max-heap (negated) of the lower half, hi: min-heap of the upper half
    slo = shi = 0
    out = []
    for x in positions:
        if not lo or x <= -lo[0]:
            heapq.heappush(lo, -x)
            slo += x
        else:
            heapq.heappush(hi, x)
            shi += x
        if len(lo) > len(hi) + 1:
            y = -heapq.heappop(lo)
            heapq.heappush(hi, y)
            slo -= y
            shi += y
        elif len(hi) > len(lo):
            y = heapq.heappop(hi)
            heapq.heappush(lo, -y)
            shi -= y
            slo += y
        med = -lo[0]
        out.append(shi - slo + (len(lo) - len(hi)) * med)
    return out
